ballots.vote: Add Andrew Wiggins, drop Kel'el Ware
ballots.rationale: Ware is a bench C (32.47 FP/g in 22.2 min over 77 GP; started 1 of 5 preseason games, and Sims started over him when Turner rested). Wiggins is a projected starter at SF with a longer record (33.78 over 68 GP, 2.13 steals and blocks a game, preseason 57.0 per 36 against Ware's 36.0), plays the same 3 Week 1 games, and is forward-eligible, so the max-4 G rule doesn't apply. The rate gain is small (+1.3 on actuals, about level on projection); the real gain is a settled role on a slot that plays most days. I keep Wilson (starter, upside) and Dejounte Murray (39.05 projection, short-term toe issue).
